measurements.name: Reconstruction error
measurements.meaning: Mean squared difference between the original feature vector and Autoencoder reconstruction.

measurements.name: Anomaly decision
measurements.meaning: True when reconstruction error exceeds the validation-selected threshold.

measurements.name: Anomaly severity
measurements.meaning: Normalized detector severity used as one input to contextual risk scoring.

measurements.name: Risk score
measurements.meaning: Weighted contextual score combining anomaly, behavior, simulated trust, and asset criticality.

label_usage: Ground-truth label is reserved for offline evaluation and is never accepted by the inference endpoint.
